review_notes: No net-new high/medium findings. The reviewed api-core surface is mature and deliberately hardened; the skill's 'skip nits' bar filters out the only lower-severity observations. Specifically confirmed clean: (1) services/jwt.rs validate_access_token/validate_refresh_token apply the token_type gate + exp + signature with pinning tests (GH #1675/#1782) — no verify-less claims read. (2) services/oauth.rs verify_pkce is S256-only, plain rejected, PKCE mandatory with absent-challenge treated as invalid_grant; token exchange checks redirect_uri + principal_kind. (3) client_ip.rs resolve_client_ip implements the full trusted-proxy pattern with rightmost-untrusted-XFF + CF-Connecting-IP opt-in gate (issue #2789), exhaustively tested — no IP spoofing. (4) services/actions/api_call.rs has connect-time SsrfGuardResolver (DNS-rebinding defense), per-redirect re-validation, cross-origin redirect refusal and scheme-downgrade blocking — no SSRF. (5) email.rs HTML digests html_escape user-controlled values — no HTML/email injection. (6) notification_pipeline dispatch_to_users uses bounded-concurrency fan-out (issue #484); background tokio::spawn tasks in workflow_executor/push_fanout/notification_pipeline log errors rather than swallow them. (7) No production-path unwrap()/expect()/panic!/todo!() in the services scanned (all hits were inside #[cfg(test)] modules). (8) No dynamic/format!-built SQL; queries go through repositories (tenant/RLS scoped) and compile-time-checked sqlx. id_ocr.rs is an intentional fail-closed Stage-A stub (trait + DTO), no testable logic.
